name: Zechariah
overview: Zechariah was a male figure identified as the son of Bebai who participated in the return to Jerusalem with Ezra. Though his tribal affiliation is not specified, his involvement with Ezra's group marks him as part of the post-exilic community seeking to restore worship and covenant faithfulness. There are no additional notes on his life or character beyond this unique identification.
namesAndTitles: The name Zechariah means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a divine attribute of God’s faithfulness and memory. This proper name, recorded in Ezra 8:11, was not given directly by God but carries the theological weight of God's ongoing remembrance of His people.
familyAndRelationships: Zechariah is explicitly identified as the son of Bebai, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this connection mentioned in Ezra 8:11.
scriptureSignificance: Zechariah's significance lies in his role as one of the individuals who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra, a key leader in the restoration of the Jewish community after exile. His mention highlights the continuity of God's people and their commitment to reestablishing proper worship and covenant obedience. Through his association with Ezra, Zechariah represents those who trusted in God's faithfulness during a critical period of spiritual renewal.
